subject: 2022 State Ballot Question 4
overview: State Representative Christine Barber discussed the upcoming 2022 ballot questions, focusing on the Work and Family Mobility Act and the Fair Share Amendment, while providing updates on local MBTA bus route changes.

items.title: Local dining favorites
items.summary: State Representative Christine Barber shared her favorite local eateries in Medford, including the Danish Pastry House and Semolina.

items.title: Ballot Question 4: Work and Family Mobility Act
items.summary: Barber explained that a "yes" vote on Question 4 preserves an existing law allowing all residents to apply for a driver's license regardless of immigration status.

items.title: Safety and economic benefits of Question 4
items.summary: The discussion highlighted how the law improves road safety by ensuring more drivers are licensed and insured, potentially lowering insurance costs based on data from other states.

items.title: Law enforcement support and privacy protections
items.summary: Barber detailed the support of local police chiefs for the law and described privacy protections designed to prevent the sharing of applicant data with federal authorities.

items.title: Ballot Question 1: Fair Share Amendment
items.summary: Barber advocated for the "millionaire's tax," which would apply a 4% tax on annual income exceeding $1 million to specifically fund education and transportation infrastructure.

items.title: Impact on Medford schools and transportation
items.summary: The discussion addressed how Fair Share revenue could be used to support early education and public higher education in Medford and across the Commonwealth.

items.title: MBTA Bus Network Redesign updates
items.summary: Barber announced that the MBTA is restoring several routes in Medford Hillside and Somerville after receiving a record number of public comments opposing proposed service cuts.
